prompt: With spot2, go to swap_bay and swap your battery there, wait 2 minutes, then check that your charge is at least 90 percent; if it is lower, stop the job as failed.

expect_2_4.because: S006 (spot2 does not list the action `swap_battery`)

why: Infeasible in 2.4: spot2 lists only `charge`, not `swap_battery` (S006), so it cannot swap its battery; only spot1 can. The fact is in the 2.3 world file too. Under 2.3 the attempt fails earlier, at the kind (`E217`) or at the action.
